Risk Statement (cause - event - conseque: Reliance on a single supplier for a critical component could lead to an extended production stoppage, delaying customer orders and triggering contractual penalties.
Existing Controls: Quarterly supplier review; 3 weeks of buffer stock held
Treatment / Action: Qualify a second supplier for the component; hold buffer stock at agreed level until qualified.

Risk Statement (cause - event - conseque: Only one person understands the month-end reconciliation process, so an extended absence would delay reporting and could allow errors to go undetected.
Existing Controls: Process runs to a monthly checklist
Treatment / Action: Document the process to a level a second person can run; cross-train one colleague.

Risk Statement (cause - event - conseque: Regulatory obligations are tracked informally, so a change in requirements could go unnoticed until a filing is missed or a review raises a finding.
Existing Controls: Ad-hoc monitoring by the finance lead
Treatment / Action: Build a documented obligations register with named owners and review dates.
